stable.notes: Saved-meeting follow-ups, reviewed Work follow-ups and clickable evidence. Sonnet defaults for fresh Meeting Ask settings; existing choices preserved. Fact check checks public claims with readable sources under explicit public-topic consent. Matched complete companion635 includes Tiny/ORT, local memory search and stable status layout. Experimental transcription and automatic cues remain off. Roof-cost comparison usefulness is limited; physical phone/Android acceptance remains pending. Signed and notarized by Apple.

whatsNew.summary: Shorter, grounded Meeting Ask answers and a Fact check button. Pairs with server6.71.12 and complete companion6.10.635.

sections.title: Ask during or after a meeting
items: Ask follow-ups on saved meetings and review an answer as linked Work with its source.
Fresh settings default to Sonnet; existing explicit model choices survive. Draft and grounding review use the selected model.
Answers preserve useful summary context and distinguish reported labor from verified time saved.

sections.title: Check a public claim
items: Fact check seeks a readable source under the existing public-topic opt-in. Private meeting details stay out of public queries.
Inline citations open their evidence. A source that was not read cannot establish a verified claim.
Roof-cost comparison usefulness remains limited; no invented average or overpricing ratio.

sections.title: Complete companion635
items: 635 includes Moonshine Tiny/ORT, phone file/image-text context, local memory keyword search, stable meeting status layout and Android pairing hardening.
Experimental transcription and automatic cue flags stay disabled. Stable transcription is unchanged.
Physical phone/G2/Android acceptance remains pending; no improved raw transcription claim.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
